outputs.discrepancies: Caption states that panel C shows photobleaching of paxillin-EGFP with the 'different light power regiments' used elsewhere in the figure (i.e. 61.6, 31.3, 4.21, 1.34 and 0.0245 mW, as in B, D, E and F) in the presence of CellROX. However, the actual panel plots ΔROS against exposure time for a completely different, unrelated set of power values (21.3, 10.8, 1.52 and 0.476 mW) as a dose–response/correlation plot with an exponential fit (R²=0.823), not as photobleaching/ROS curves obtained under the power regimens defined for the rest of the figure. The mismatch between the conditions implied by the caption and those actually plotted makes it unclear that this panel represents the same experimental regimens referenced in the caption.
